newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Aurora Mt Muro gold mine hit by low river.
newsitem.headline: Aurora Mt Muro gold mine hit by low river.

text.p: Aurora Gold Ltd said on Wednesday it held sufficient supplies at its Mount Muro mine in Indonesia's East Kalimantan province to ride out a dry spell that has halted river barge traffic to the site.
The water level of the Barito River has dropped to a level that is unnavigable for large craft, including the ocean-going barges used for the supply of stores to the mine site, it said

"The operation is currently reliant upon the Barito River for the supply of stores and accordingly carries inflated inventory levels of most consumable items as a safeguard against prolonged periods of low river levels," the company said.
Stocks of all consumables, other than diesel fuel, are sufficient to maintain normal operations for at least three months, it added.

Currently fuel is sufficient for normal operations for a minimum of three weeks and additional supplies, previously marooned on the river, are being conveyed to site by small craft, extending fuel stores for another two weeks, Aurora said.
Mount Muro produces about 230,000 ounces of gold a year.
